text: Owner asked how to distinguish sound/salvageable retained work from stale branches. Added docs/verification/migration-recovery-ledger-20261005.md and .json: all 146 original tips plus all 166 remote preservation refs, refreshed ancestry against handoff 4f17260f, original path/disposition evidence, literal audited open-Mote references (34 tips), and per-disposition next actions. Remaining feature deltas require authoritative Mote acceptance, current replacement evidence, bounded current-base ports, exact-candidate review, JVM/Scala.js and applicable scientific/native/resource/consumer gates. Unqualified does not mean bad; source-history presence, age, conflicts and old green logs do not prove readiness. Known deferred seams are explicitly linked; missing feature-to-Mote coverage is an assessment gap. No blanket qualification or stale-work deletion is claimed.
